transcript.text: Because there is no controllable kitchen light available, the plan will try to brighten nearby rooms by turning on the bathroom and utility-room lights. For each light, if it is already on nothing changes; otherwise it will be set to 100% brightness and the system will wait up to 5 seconds to confirm it turned on. These other-room lights may or may not sufficiently improve visibility in the kitchen. Does this plan look good to you?
